about.title: About Hearthlands
about.summary: Hearthlands gathers the corpus's recurring domestic geography: homes, gardens, rooms, thresholds, water and the figures and objects that repeatedly inhabit them. Its six canonical places and wider motif/symbol field were derived from the v57 corpus model rather than invented as fantasy-map decoration.
